"""Reviewer's ad-hoc check (round 2): check_act on the G1 reuse path. Not part of the package."""
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

CLONE = Path("/tmp/gov-launch-independent-auditor-f8htaub2/claude-1000/r2review/clone")
NEW = CLONE / ".gov-runtime/scratch/orchestrator/drafts/act-operator-rounds/code/governance/project/operator"
sys.path.insert(0, str(CLONE / "tests/unit/operator"))
from test_w2_148_kit import Kit, approve  # noqa: E402


def to_new_code(kit):
    for f in ("operator_run.py", "verdict.py"):
        p = kit.install / f
        p.chmod(0o644)
        shutil.copyfile(NEW / f, p)
    (kit.install / "APPROVED").chmod(0o644)
    approve(kit.install)


def strip_act(kit, act):
    mp = kit.scratch / "acts" / act / "manifest.json"
    m = json.loads(mp.read_text())
    m.pop("act")
    raw = json.dumps(m, indent=1).encode()
    mp.write_bytes(raw)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def test_reuse_path_refuses_a_frozen_copy_without_act(tmp_path):
    kit = Kit(tmp_path)                                   # the clone's committed (old) code
    kit.bundle("ACT-RU1", {("repo", "tests/optin-x.txt"): b"one\nthree\n"}, rounds=1)
    msha = strip_act(kit, "ACT-RU1")
    rc, res, _ = kit.run("run", "ACT-RU1", msha)
    print("old code:", res)
    assert list((kit.root / "acts").glob("ACT-RU1-*")), "old code froze nothing"
    g1_old = [e for e in kit.log() if e["gate"] == "G1"]
    assert g1_old and g1_old[-1]["result"] == "pass"     # the old code let it through G1
    to_new_code(kit)
    rc, res, _ = kit.run("run", "ACT-RU1", msha)          # same sha: the reuse path
    print("new code:", res)
    assert rc != 0 and res["gate"] == "G1" and "names no act" in res["reason"], res


def test_reuse_path_passes_g1_with_act(tmp_path):
    kit = Kit(tmp_path)
    to_new_code(kit)
    msha = kit.bundle("ACT-RU2", {("repo", "tests/optin-x.txt"): b"one\nthree\n"}, rounds=1)
    rc, res, _ = kit.run("run", "ACT-RU2", msha)
    print("first:", res)
    rc, res, _ = kit.run("run", "ACT-RU2", msha)          # second request, same sha: the reuse path
    print("second:", res)
    g1 = [e for e in kit.log() if e["gate"] == "G1"]
    print("G1 lines:", g1)
    assert len(g1) == 2 and all(e["result"] == "pass" for e in g1)

No regression: all 13 distinct ACT manifests under scratch and the 6 live frozen copies name their own id. The bundle folder is `<scratch>/acts/<act>/`, so the request id and the folder id are the same string. `undo_step` reads the frozen manifest directly, so `check_act` can never block an undo. |
| **P1-F2** (undo trusted the repository backup) | **Closed; adds a refusal only.** Before taking the lock or writing, each repository backup file must hash to its expected before value. Rehearsed: a backup altered together with its `SHA256SUMS` is refused "is not the before file … nothing changed", and the tree and install are unchanged. |
